subject: Prepaid commitment: staggered invoicing plan, drawdown windows & VAT evidence request
messages:
From: Jake Lomas <jake.lomas@acme-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prepay commitment - approach and first invoice

Kim / Ben / Monica —

Thanks again for the commitment conversation last week. ACME is ready to move forward with the $360k annual prepay for the next 12 months. A couple of items on our side before we finalize:

1) We prefer a staggered invoicing cadence (3x) tied to product milestones (50% on signing, 30% at go-live, 20% 90 days after go-live). Can Redwood produce three invoices and allow drawdowns against the committed balance?

2) VAT: our finance team needs proof of Redwood's VAT status for Germany and an invoice template that includes VAT breakdown per line.

3) Can you confirm timing for the first invoice (we'd like it within 5 business days of the signed SOW) and the bank wiring instructions?

If you send a sample invoice and the VAT doc, I can route to AP.

Best,
Jake
Jake Lomas
Head of Platform Ops, ACME Analytics
accounts-payable@acme-analytics.com

Attachment: SOW-ACME-Q3-2027.pdf (referenced)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jake Lomas <jake.lomas@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prepay commitment - approach and first invoice

Jake —

Appreciate the clear ask. High level we can support the 3x staggered invoicing and drawdown against a committed ledger. To make this smooth I want to confirm the operational plan so we can hand off to finance:

• Invoice 1 (50%) — issued within 3 business days after SOW signature; funds posted to Redwood prepay ledger and available immediately for drawdown.
• Invoice 2 (30%) — milestone invoiced at go-live; funds posted within 2 business days of receipt.
• Invoice 3 (20%) — final invoice 90 days after go-live.

Actions I will take now:
1) Ben, Vivek — please prepare a seed invoice (prepay-invoice-001.xlsx) template that includes line-level VAT and alternate wiring instructions for SEPA/ACH. Can you also confirm whether we can support the 3-drawdown windows in our ledger and any timing restrictions?
2) Monica — I’ll send ACME the Redwood VAT certificate for DE and a sample invoice PDF.

Jake, I’ll send the two attachments and the first invoice once Ben confirms numbers. If ACME needs net terms or a different banking flow tell me and we’ll surface to finance.

Thanks —
Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachments: prepay-invoice-001.xlsx (will be populated), ACME_vat-proof-DE-2026.pdf (sample)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Prepay commitment - approach and first invoice

Team —

Quick finance note after reviewing the proposed cadence: we can support the 3-invoice model and maintain a committed-balance ledger with drawdown. A few operational constraints and recommendations:

• Ledger behavior: funds from Invoice 1 will be available immediately for service drawdown, but refunds/realignment requests must be raised within 30 days of the invoice date.
• Batching: to optimize token billing we recommend customers set a preferred drawdown schedule; otherwise calls will consume against the committed bucket FIFO.
• VAT handling: for DE VAT we need the customer's DE VAT ID and their AP contact for local tax evidence. Our AP team will attach the VAT proof to the invoice PDF.
• Wire vs ACH: prefer ACH (US) for speed; for SEPA we need IBAN + BIC.

I’ve attached the working invoice template (prepay-invoice-001.xlsx) and a sample populated PDF for review.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: prepay-invoice-001.xlsx, sample-populated-invoice.pdf

• Our DE VAT ID: DE123456789.
• Banking options — ACH (preferred) or SEPA (provide IBAN/BIC).

We will sign the SOW today and initiate payment once we receive the first invoice PDF. If you can include the drawdown policy summary on page 2 of the invoice PDF that helps our ledger team.

Jake
